name: Historic Centre of the City of Pienza
description: Pienza is a small hill town in Tuscany's Val d'Orcia, between Montepulciano and Montalcino. In 1459 Pope Pius II set out to rebuild his birthplace, and architect Bernardo Rossellino created a Renaissance ideal town around the elegant Piazza Pio II. Its square is framed by the Piccolomini and Borgia palaces and a cathedral with a pale Renaissance façade and a Gothic-style interior.
